status: Optional Path foundation selected only by NODE_COMPAT_PATH=ON; core m0.1 manifest is unchanged.
moduleContract: Explicit finite ESM export records. Root default equals posix; default and named functions initially share identity; all variants share the same posix/win32 object graph. Bare aliases select the same values, with module namespace records cached per registered specifier.

node:path.callablePolicy: All 13 callable exports implement lexical path operations; matchesGlob additionally enforces explicit profile budgets. No operation consults a host capability.
deviations: Default namespace is POSIX and virtual cwd is always '/'; no host cwd or drive-specific environment is queried.
matchesGlob uses fixed POSIX-host case sensitivity for both variants, suppresses Node's experimental warning and uses explicitly patched minimatch 11.0.1 rather than Node 22.14's vulnerable matcher.
matchesGlob rejects resource-budget exhaustion with RangeError code ERR_SM_NODE_PATH_BUDGET and a resource string instead of truncating expansions or returning a false result.
TypeError names and ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE codes match the supported invalid input domain; received-value message rendering differs from Node's internal inspector.
Default path objects remain mutable; ESM named bindings capture their initial members. syncBuiltinESMExports is unavailable.
